name: Raeticodactylus
isnote: Grouped with Caviramus in Raeticodactylidae (Andres et al. 2014); its broader relationships are unstable.
sum: Crested Late Triassic pterosaur from the Kössen Formation of Grisons, Switzerland.
holotype: BNM 14524 — Alplihorn Member, Kössen Formation, Grisons (found 2005).
material: Disarticulated partial skeleton with an almost complete skull.
exceptional: Tall thin crest on the upper jaw and a keel under the lower jaw.
biology: Fang-like front teeth and multi-cusped cheek teeth; may have been a fish-eater (the skim-feeding idea is now rejected).
author: Stecher 2008
